# Run A: `112 101`

**Argument resolution.** Two PR tokens are present, so this run takes the set-routing row and follows `reference/batch.md`. Steps 1-7 do not run directly from here.

**Admission (before any effects).**
1. `git remote get-url origin` returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. After stripping `.git` and lowercasing, the origin is `acme/widgets`.
2. Both bare numbers normalize to `acme/widgets#112` and `acme/widgets#101`.
   - There are no duplicates.
   - There are no URLs, so no URL can name a foreign repository.
   - There is no positional issue reference.
3. The harness is pi. The active pi-cohort `parallel.maxTasks` is 4 and the set has 2 PRs, so the set is within the cap.
4. This is a typed set, so no `discovered, smallest first:` line is printed. The supplied order (112, then 101) is preserved.

**Mint the parent run folder.** I mint one `RUN_DIR` from the session checkout through `post-selection-loop.md` `### Continuation record`, before any roster or record exists. It succeeds. No roster, per-PR record or tracker task is created yet, because those come after provisioning.

**Gather, in token order.** Each admitted token is passed unchanged as `pr_token`:
- `pr_token=112`: `gh pr view "$pr_token" --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '<batch.md linearRefs projection>'`. It returns the #112 row.
- `pr_token=101`: the same command. It returns the #101 row.

**Viewer reads (once each, typed set).**
- `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`.
- `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns `acme/reviewers`.

**Ticket-display configuration from origin's default branch.**
- `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` returns `origin/main`.
- `git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md` and `git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md` show no tracker override. Linear IDs therefore stay allowed, but neither PR needs one.

**Entry derivation.**
- **#112**
  - Author `pat` is not the viewer, and there are no pending review requests, so the reason is `by pat`.
  - The first closing reference is #22 in `acme/widgets`, which is origin, so it is labeled `#22` and linked to its own URL.
- **#101**
  - Author `alex` matches the viewer, so the reason is `yours`.
  - There are no closing references.
  - The head branch `gh-45-retry` starts with `gh-45`, which gives origin issue #45.

The list goes out as its own message, with no marker and no wait:

---
PRs to gate:
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - centralize settings reads through one resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout for slow requests
---

**Next step:** serial provisioning (`batch.md` `## Provision serially`).
- Resolve trusted worktree configuration from the base merge-base.
- Run one `git fetch origin`.
- Provision #112, then #101, one at a time.
- No `--rebase` was passed, so there is no confirmation question.

---

# Run B: `97`

**Argument resolution.** One typed PR token is present, so this is the single-PR path. Discovery does not run and set routing does not apply.

**Step 1 Gather (Section A fixed commands).**
- The first view's URL supplies `acme/widgets`.
- `<headRefOid>` stands for the head SHA that view returns. It is the commit verification and review will later assess.
- Then the Ticket-display configuration reads run against `origin/main`.

Run B:
```bash
gh pr view 97 --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests
gh run list -R acme/widgets -c <headRefOid> --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url
gh api user --jq .login
gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'
gh api graphql -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!){ repository(owner:$o,name:$r){ viewerPermission pullRequest(number:$n){ viewerCanUpdateBranch viewerCanMergeAsAdmin viewerCanClose headRefOid body baseRefName } } }' -f o=acme -f r=widgets -F n=97
gh repo view acme/widgets --json nameWithOwner
gh pr diff 97 -R acme/widgets
gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/reviews --paginate
gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/comments --paginate
gh api repos/acme/widgets/issues/97/comments --paginate
git worktree list --porcelain
git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md
```
---
PR to gate:
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - add a csv export button for the widget list
---
Paired call: `mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gate.XXXXXX"`

**Entry derivation.**
- **Reason:** author `robin` is not the viewer. The pending User request is for `alex`, which matches the viewer, so the reason is `by robin, requested from you`.
- **Ticket:**
  - There are no closing references.
  - Branch `csv-export` holds no `gh-<N>` and no Linear-shaped ID.
  - The title holds no issue token.
  - `linearRefs` is empty.
  - The ticket is therefore `no ticket`.
- **Linear lookup:** none of the three override paths exists, so Linear lookup stays allowed. No Linear ID remains to resolve, so no `linearis` lookup runs.

**Initialization, in workflow order (sent with the list, no wait).**
1. The paired call mints the run folder.
2. I initialize its continuation record per `post-selection-loop.md` `### Continuation record`, using `course: null`, zero repair usage, `approved_head: null`, `work_started: false` and the gathered consent target `acme/widgets#97`/`main`.
3. `plan_tracker` `init` with three stages: `gather`, `provision`, `verify`. There is no `--rebase`, so there is no `sync` stage. Then `gather` is marked complete.

**Next step:** step 2, Provision + configure (`reference/assessment.md`). I stop here, before any provisioning.

Run A:

1. Parse `112 101` as a typed set, preserving that order.
2. Run `git remote get-url origin`. Normalize the result to `acme/widgets` for admission. Read the active pi-cohort configuration: the two PRs fit its four-task limit, and admission passes.
3. Mint the parent run folder with `mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gate.XXXXXX"`. Initialize its continuation record before creating roster entries or initializing progress.
4. Gather each PR in argument order, running this command first with `pr_token=112`, then with `pr_token=101`:

   `gh pr view "$pr_token" --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'`

5. Run `gh api user --jq .login`, followed by `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'`.
6. Run `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`. Check the project override paths on that default-branch ref in the prescribed order for ticket-display configuration.
7. Render the typed list without sorting it by change size:

---
PRs to gate:
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - centralize settings reads through one resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout
---

Next step: provision the PR worktrees serially in roster order, beginning with the parent's single `git fetch origin`. Stop before that step: no fetch, worktree creation, or helper dispatch has occurred. The parent tracker uses `pr-112 state: <record path>` and `pr-101 state: <record path>` once those per-PR records are initialized; no child-stage tracker has started.

For independent Run B, the first shell call below mints its run folder. Immediately afterward, initialize its continuation record, then call `plan_tracker.init` with `gather`, `provision`, and `verify`, and start `gather`. These initialization operations precede the PR view; they do not provision a worktree.

Run B:
```bash

gh pr view 97 --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests
gh run list -R acme/widgets -c "$headRefOid" --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url
gh api user --jq .login
gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'
gh api graphql -f query='query($o:String!,$r:String!,$n:Int!){ repository(owner:$o,name:$r){ viewerPermission pullRequest(number:$n){ viewerCanUpdateBranch viewerCanMergeAsAdmin viewerCanClose headRefOid body baseRefName } } }' -f o=acme -f r=widgets -F n=97
gh repo view acme/widgets --json nameWithOwner
gh pr diff 97
gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/reviews --paginate
gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/comments --paginate
gh api repos/acme/widgets/issues/97/comments --paginate
git worktree list --porcelain
git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md
```
---
PR to gate:
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - add a CSV export button to the widget list
---
Paired call: `git fetch origin`

That paired call identifies the next provisioning command; it has not run. Run B derives `acme/widgets` from the first PR view's URL, not from a separate origin lookup, and uses that view's head for the Actions-run query.

Close `gather`. Next step: start `provision` and perform step 2, provisioning and configuration. Stop here: neither run has dispatched a helper, verified a commit, produced an assessment, or rendered a menu.
